issue: Connecticut replaced its 8 counties with 9 planning regions in 2022. As of the 2025 release, CHR provides snapshots for both the nine planning regions and eight former counties, but with different measures available for each. A clean crosswalk is not feasible. Decision required: exclude Connecticut entirely from the panel.
action_taken: Recommendation: exclude Connecticut. The split measure availability across planning regions and former counties makes a consistent longitudinal record not feasible for most variables.
reference: CHR 2025 Technical Document, Appendix 1: FIPS code changes

issue: The uninsured measure column name changed between 2011 and 2012. In 2010-2011 the ranked measure was Uninsured Adults (v003_rawvalue). From 2012 onward it became Uninsured all-ages (v085_rawvalue). In 2025 the column was renumbered again to v059_rawvalue. These are not the same measure population. A decision is required on whether to use 2010-2011 as an adults-only bridge or exclude those years from the primary outcome series.
action_taken: 2025 confirmed: v059_rawvalue. 2012-2024: v085_rawvalue. 2010-2011: v003_rawvalue (adults only). Decision pending on 2010-2011 inclusion.

issue: CHR release year does not equal the survey measurement year. Analysis must use measurement year on the time axis, not release year. Confirmed across all years: the uninsured measure draws from SAHIE single-year estimates, with a consistent lag of approximately 2-3 years behind the release year.
action_taken: All 15 years verified as SAHIE. Measurement years confirmed and recorded in release_measure_year_map.csv. 2024 is the only unverified year (codebook only available).
reference: Annual CHR Analytic Dataset Codebooks 2010-2025; outputs/release_measure_year_map.csv

issue: Originally flagged as a risk that the uninsured source might vary between SAHIE and ACS across years. Resolved: all confirmed years (2010-2023 and 2025) consistently use SAHIE. The source has been SAHIE throughout the full study period. This flag can be closed.
action_taken: RESOLVED: SAHIE used consistently across all verified release years. No ACS transition exists for the uninsured measure.

issue: The 2010 and 2011 releases measured uninsured adults only (v003). Starting in 2012 CHR switched to an all-ages uninsured measure (v085). This is a substantive change in the measure population that creates a structural break between 2011 and 2012. The all-ages rate will generally differ from the adult-only rate in counties with large child populations. Decision required: start the primary panel in 2012, or include 2010-2011 with the adult measure as a secondary comparison series.
action_taken: Decision pending. Recommend starting the primary panel in 2012 for a clean all-ages series. Include 2010-2011 adult uninsured as the independent extension comparison (RQ1).
